description: GX-20 (B-14, GA-P01, D-070): a PR gate whose delta from an earlier passed v4 proof on the same base, toolchain and gate version stays inside gate-carry.carry_over_areas runs the delta plan (always-stages, structure check included, plus the covers-matching script tests) and carries every other stage of that proof (carried_from). Off is the rollback: every run is a normal gate.
